requirements.obligation: Generated answers and correlated evidence cannot become independent external observations.

requirements.obligation: Recovery claims must fit O capabilities and seven-day retention.

requirements.obligation: Occurrence identity, content equality and physical identity are distinct.

requirements.obligation: Finite inquiry, inference and storage work must yield to native intake.
requirements.flowdown: R/X propagate bounded budgets; each owner enforces admission; native intake has separately reserved capacity.

requirements.obligation: Schema, model and embedding versions cannot be silently mixed.
requirements.flowdown: Producers label versions; S and consumers reject incompatible spaces or select explicit migrations.

requirements.obligation: Outside model/source/action/infrastructure dependencies require explicit authority and failure behavior.
requirements.flowdown: Callers own disclosure/cost; external results confer no commit or physical action authority.

bounded-grounded-v1.ownership: Sender owns its request/result record; receiver owns admission and its local durable state. No interface transfers state-domain commit authority. S alone owns representations, physical-identity decisions and accepted state; O owns retained source envelopes.
bounded-grounded-v1.authority: Only the operation allowlist on this contract is permitted. Read transport and receipt are not mutation acceptance or independently observed external effects. Direct foreign-store writes, authority delegation and unspecified actions are denied.
bounded-grounded-v1.shape_versions: Proposed typed envelope: schema_version, operation, request_id, actor, payload, provenance and optional expected_revision. Preserve unknown/native fields or explicitly reject unsupported versions; unknown is not false/zero. Result includes correlation ID and outcome. Endpoint schemas do not yet exist.
bounded-grounded-v1.identity_scope: Request identity is (caller identity, caller epoch, stable request_id); conflicting reuse is rejected. Observation occurrence, payload hash, source identity and physical entity are distinct identifiers. Carry source/epoch/occurrence and derivation/correction references; never infer physical sameness from a hash.
bounded-grounded-v1.time_order: Carry source event/valid time when known, source clock uncertainty, O receipt time, S commit/knowledge revision and model time/version when used. Cursor orders the O receipt stream only; no global source-time order. Late corrections refer to prior revisions.
bounded-grounded-v1.delivery_idempotency: Queries may be retried within the caller budget. Proposals require a stable request ID and payload fingerprint before first send; duplicate returns original disposition, reordered/stale proposals conflict explicitly. Timeout is unknown completion; reread local owner state before retry. Cancellation is best effort and never reverses durable commits.
bounded-grounded-v1.commit_recovery: Transport receipt is not commit. Receiver records applied request/occurrence IDs with the state mutation in one local durable transaction. Requests hold no foreign-store locks; crash before commit permits retry and crash after commit returns prior outcome. Store durability and transaction capability remain unverified.
bounded-grounded-v1.retention: O native payload availability is seven days, subject to unresolved exact expiry semantics. S keeps provenance metadata/references indefinitely as stated; reference lifetime does not extend payload lifetime. Return unavailable/expired with known horizon; retain gap and correction metadata. No unbounded replay or implicit archive.
bounded-grounded-v1.resource_limits: Fail closed until a policy specifies finite payload/result bytes, items/page, queue depth, concurrency, total deadline, attempts, model context/output tokens, monetary cost and storage admission. One work ID carries remaining budget across R/X/M and reads, including failed work; owners enforce rather than reset it. Native intake has positive reserved capacity; inquiry yields at its quota. Numeric settings and measured capacity are open.
bounded-grounded-v1.errors: Typed outcomes: ok, unknown, unavailable/expired, unsupported_version, denied, conflict, timeout, cancelled, partial and budget_exhausted; identify owner and request. Retry only transient outcomes within the remaining budget; never retry denied, expired, unsupported or exhausted indefinitely. Partial output carries coverage/gap fields.
bounded-grounded-v1.feedback_grounding: Carry native/generated classification, source occurrences, model/version/prompt lineage, selection/missingness and parent work IDs. Generated results remain inference, shared model/evidence counts once for independence, proposals remain proposals until S admission, and operational acceptance never proves external truth.

facets.authority: Only get(id) and subscribe(cursor) are allowed on the existing O read surface; subscribe is used by S, R uses get for missing known observations. There is no O acknowledge, lease, acquisition action, subscriber commit or deletion API. R is denied append of generated material.
facets.commit_recovery: O read requests do not commit consumer state. S resumes from its own durable cursor after atomic local commit; R records read outcomes within its work record. Neither request nor transport response protects O data from seven-day expiry.
facets.shape_versions: Existing endpoint names are known, but native wire schemas are absent. Proposed request includes get id or opaque subscribe cursor, request correlation and bounded page/bytes/deadline selectors; a request ID is reader correlation, not an invented O mutation capability.

facets.authority: O returns only retained source envelopes or explicit unknown/unavailable/gap outcomes to the requesting reader. Delivery conveys neither physical identity truth nor S acceptance and is not an acknowledgement capability.
facets.shape_versions: Proposed source envelope preserves opaque native payload plus O occurrence id, source claim/epoch if known, payload hash, source/receipt times, native/generated type and opaque cursor for subscribe. Source claims remain unverified unless separately authenticated. Absent version/epoch/time is explicit unknown; get/subscribe schema and gap semantics await endpoint agreement.
facets.delivery_idempotency: O may redeliver an occurrence; S uses occurrence IDs, never content hashes, to suppress duplicate application. Cursor continuity, duplicate/reorder and invalid/expired cursor outcomes must be specified. R correlates get results; query timeout grants no acquisition authority.
facets.commit_recovery: O durability of append and snapshot/subscription handoff is not specified. S may claim recovery only after its own atomic representation/applied-occurrence/cursor commit and only within actual O availability. No acknowledgement is assumed.

facets.authority: Requester may read an authorized S snapshot and proposal disposition; it may not mutate S through this read, issue physical actions or request native O payload transit.
facets.shape_versions: Proposed selector includes representation/identity/acceptance IDs, revision/as-of knowledge scope, supported schema/embedding spaces and projection. Status lookup uses the same read request with proposal request_id; bounded paging and gap indicators are required.
facets.commit_recovery: Snapshot read is nonmutating; consumer persists its own requested revision/work record if needed. A read response may be stale and cannot reserve or lock S state.

facets.ownership: S produces and owns durable representation, identity and accepted-state snapshots; R/X own only their derived working/report state. S response includes its revision and the provenance needed to interpret scope.
facets.authority: S releases an authorized projection; no read result grants commit authority or physical/source truth. X receives representation/confidence summaries and availability/lineage metadata, never native O payloads.
facets.shape_versions: Proposed snapshot includes schema/revision, state kind, unknowns, source/generation/correction lineage, evidence availability and as-of scope. Embeddings keyed by (model provider, model identifier, revision, preprocessing, dimension, normalization, metric); unsupported spaces are rejected or explicitly selected, never pooled.
facets.commit_recovery: S serves one committed revision or clearly marks partial/mixed revision. Consumers report that revision; delayed responses cannot override newer state. Store snapshot capability remains unverified.

facets.commit_recovery: S stores disposition, applied request ID and committed revision atomically with the admitted mutation. Crash recovery must reproduce disposition; pending is never reported as accepted.

facets.authority: R submits a proposal only; S validates provenance, supported version, expected revision and admission policy before any commit. Direct writes to S are denied. S rejects inadequate/conflicting evidence or retains an explicitly pending proposal.
facets.shape_versions: Proposed payload includes kind, stable request ID, expected S revision, scoped proposed change, supporting occurrence/derivation references, unknowns and reason. Unsupported extensions and incompatible versions produce explicit errors.
facets.commit_recovery: S alone atomically records applied proposal ID, resulting state/correction lineage and disposition. R owns durable retry/work identity, not S state. If S admission rules are absent the proposal stays pending or denied; no write-through.
facets.feedback_grounding: Generated inference is a distinct S record type with parent observations, M version/prompt/transform lineage, selection scope and availability. It is never reclassified as native external evidence, and cannot increase independent support merely by recurrence.

facets.authority: X may propose a simplified accepted-state projection at an expected S revision; S alone validates and commits accepted state. X cannot directly replace representations or physical IDs. Acceptance is operational status, never external truth.

contracts.title: X asks a scoped reasoning question

facets.ownership: X owns reporting question/work identity and bounded request; R owns inquiry execution/status. S remains state authority and O remains source-envelope owner.
facets.authority: X asks for reasoning over authorized S projections; R may read S/O and optionally invoke permitted M operations within budget, and may propose to S. No external acquisition or physical action is authorized by a question.
facets.shape_versions: Proposed question includes request/work ID, question, S revision/as-of scope, permitted data projections, requested uncertainty/coverage fields and remaining total budget; missing capability or scope returns an explicit error.

facets.ownership: X owns reporting question/work identity and bounded request; R owns inquiry execution/status. S remains state authority and O remains source-envelope owner.
facets.authority: Suggestion conveys no acquisition permission or obligation to retry. R may reread existing O ids; a new outside observation needs a separately approved provider/action capability. Current absent provider yields acquisition_unavailable.
facets.shape_versions: Suggestion includes stable work ID, sought evidence/known O ids, reason/selection policy, temporal scope, remaining budget and optional named capability; a capability name alone conveys no authority.

facets.ownership: R owns the generated answer and lineage record; X owns reporting; S owns any later admitted state. Result is not a S acceptance decision.
facets.authority: R returns inference, uncertainty and missingness; X can report or propose a projection to S. Neither may present inference or shared-model agreement as independent native evidence.
facets.shape_versions: Proposed answer includes question/work ID, S revision/as-of scope, generated flag, claims/support refs, model/version and shared-dependency lineage, availability/selection limits and outcome; confidence is uncalibrated unless separately measured.

facets.authority: R reports read outcome, exhausted, unavailable, denied or cancelled; it cannot claim a newly observed effect without an independently grounded receipt from a named authorized source. There is currently no such outside capability.
facets.shape_versions: Proposed status includes work/request ID, attempted known O ids, result occurrence refs if available, missing provider/authority, attempts and remaining budget, coverage gaps and final/nonfinal status.

facets.ownership: R or X owns disclosure admission, per-work budget and durable request identity. M independently governs model execution and any provider retention; M is an external dependency, not a fifth application owner.
facets.authority: Only stateless inference over explicitly admitted projections is proposed. M receives no O/S store credentials, update authority, acquisition tools or physical actions. Calls stay disabled until data disclosure, tenancy, retention and cost policies are agreed.
facets.shape_versions: Proposed model request labels task, request/work ID, allowed context projection, schema/prompt/preprocessing/model provider+identifier+revision, requested output schema and finite token/time/cost limits. Never send native payloads through X.
facets.identity_scope: Work/request ID is stable locally; it does not imply M idempotent billing or execution. Model/version and input lineage are explicit; provider run ID is recorded if returned, never assumed.
facets.delivery_idempotency: Timeout may mean M executed and charged. No automatic retry without remaining total budget and acknowledged possible duplicate cost; M offers no assumed cancellation or dedup API. A local duplicate request is suppressed before dispatch.
facets.commit_recovery: Caller durably records admitted request and budget reservation before dispatch, then result/uncertain completion. A crash cannot grant another fresh budget. M output never commits S/O and provider execution cannot be rolled back by a local cancellation.
facets.retention: Proposed transmitted context minimization and provider data retention/deletion/tenant isolation are unconfirmed. Disable disclosure until agreed; S references to model outputs do not imply indefinite provider replay.
facets.resource_limits: Complete cost includes context construction, input/output tokens, calls, failed/duplicate work, queues, caller derivation and retained outputs. Enforce shared work deadline/attempt/token/cost caps and global R/X concurrency/rate limits; numeric caps and provider quotas are unresolved; denied policy means no call.

facets.authority: M result is advisory generated material only; caller validates schema and permitted scope. A model confidence token, agreement or tool-looking string grants no observation, action or commit capability.
facets.shape_versions: Proposed result includes request correlation, provider run/model/version when known, generated content, outcome, usage/cost when available and truncation/uncertainty markers. Missing version/usage remains unknown and blocks incompatible embedding admission or budget closure.
facets.identity_scope: Preserve caller work ID plus provider run ID when available; no physical/source identity is established by model output. S embeds only in an explicitly versioned space.
facets.commit_recovery: Caller may retain a validated generated result and update local budget atomically; any S admission is a separate proposal. Late/cancelled results cannot resurrect exhausted work or commit state.
facets.retention: Caller retention follows admitted policy; provider replay/deletion is not assumed. Preserve minimal model/version/input-lineage and known support availability when an output is retained.
facets.feedback_grounding: Mark every output generated; R/X share M failure/calibration/selection biases. Combined agreement is correlated, not independent support. Generated output may guide inquiry but cannot enter O as ordinary native evidence.

cases.stimulus: Repeat identical payload twice at one source and once at another; duplicate delivery of one occurrence.
cases.expected: Three distinct occurrences survive; only redelivery of the same occurrence ID is idempotent; hash equality never merges physical identities.
cases.verification_kind: planned implementation case; design counterexample only

cases.stimulus: Crash before, during and after S representation/applied-ID/cursor transaction, then reconnect O subscribe(cursor).
cases.expected: Before commit replay is harmless; after commit cursor resumes; no O acknowledgement is sent or relied on. Atomic checkpoint failure blocks recovery qualification.
cases.verification_kind: planned implementation case; design counterexample only

cases.stimulus: Restart S after eight days, request an expired O id, and inspect an indefinitely retained S reference.
cases.expected: Gap and unavailable evidence are durable and visible; S does not promise replay or verifiability; reports disclose stale/unavailable support.
cases.verification_kind: planned implementation case; design counterexample only

cases.stimulus: Attempt R physical-ID write and X accepted-state write; submit proposals with stale expected S revision and conflicting aliases.
cases.expected: Direct writes are denied; only S commits, conflicts are explicit; insufficient evidence remains a proposal and never becomes external truth.
cases.verification_kind: planned implementation case; design counterexample only

cases.stimulus: Route a generated M answer through R, then try O append and reuse of the answer as independent support.
cases.expected: R generated append is denied; S records generated lineage; X excludes it from independent evidence counts and exposes upstream dependencies.
cases.verification_kind: planned implementation case; design counterexample only

cases.stimulus: Read embeddings from two model revisions with equal dimension but different spaces; submit old-schema or missing-version material.
cases.expected: No cross-space similarity or confidence pooling; explicit unsupported outcome or version-specific path; migrations retain source and transformation lineage.
cases.verification_kind: planned implementation case; design counterexample only

cases.stimulus: Duplicate, reorder, cancel and retry a proposal/question after an unknown response.
cases.expected: Stable caller request IDs and payload fingerprints reproduce prior results or conflict; caller checks status through the same S read operation; cancellation does not undo commits.
cases.verification_kind: planned implementation case; design counterexample only

cases.stimulus: Force repeated unavailable reads and model timeouts while sustained native append load is present.
cases.expected: Inquiry exhausts shared total attempts/deadline/tokens/cost and yields; native intake retains its configured positive reservation; admission denial is explicit; no circular wait holds O/S commit locks.
cases.verification_kind: planned implementation case; design counterexample only

cases.stimulus: Request a newly observed outside fact when only O cached get/subscribe exists, or name a provider without authorization.
cases.expected: Return acquisition_unavailable with missing capability/authority; no invented source action, acknowledgement or effect; external acquisition gate remains blocked.
cases.verification_kind: planned implementation case; design counterexample only

cases.stimulus: X proposes simplified acceptance after a newer S revision/correction arrives.
cases.expected: S rejects stale update or requires refreshed proposal; reported acceptance remains distinct from operational acceptance and external truth.
cases.verification_kind: planned implementation case; design counterexample only

cases.stimulus: M times out, returns partial/unsupported output, or requires disclosure not admitted by policy.
cases.expected: No call without disclosure, retention and cost policy; late outputs are noncommitting; budget is charged for failed work; summaries degrade to unavailable/unknown.
cases.verification_kind: planned implementation case; design counterexample only

cases.stimulus: Try X native O access and model direct writes to O/S; trace any shared-store credential bypass.
cases.expected: No O-X payload lane, no O-M/S-M authority; storage isolation preserves logical owners; no hidden channel bypasses contracts.
cases.verification_kind: planned implementation case; design counterexample only

cases.stimulus: R and X use the same M and the same S observations; inquiry selectively samples favorable cases.
cases.expected: Confidence reports common model/evidence lineage and selection/missingness; agreement is not independent confirmation; no unsupported calibration claim.
cases.verification_kind: planned implementation case; design counterexample only

cases.stimulus: R rereads an available id, a never-seen id, and an expired id through O get.
cases.expected: Read result correlates to the request; available/unknown/unavailable remain distinct; no external observation is fabricated from absence.
cases.verification_kind: planned implementation case; design counterexample only

cases.stimulus: Submit unknown fields, temporal correction and alias retraction with original occurrence references.
cases.expected: Native unknown is preserved, correction links to prior state, event/valid-time scope survives, and old versions are not silently overwritten.
cases.verification_kind: planned implementation case; design counterexample only

cases.stimulus: Source clock regresses and observations arrive late or out of source-time order across a new source epoch.
cases.expected: Receipt/commit/cursor order is separate from event time; uncertainty and gaps survive; no global physical-time ordering is claimed.
cases.verification_kind: planned implementation case; design counterexample only

cases.stimulus: Native source append succeeds durably but its reply is lost; source retries with/without an agreed source-event ID; crash O around receipt persistence.
cases.expected: Actual O response only promises pinned durability; reply loss remains unknown completion; agreed idempotency works only if explicitly supported, otherwise duplicate occurrences stay distinct. No consumer acknowledgement or lookup-by-request capability is assumed.
cases.verification_kind: planned implementation case; design counterexample only

cases.stimulus: R and X request snapshots/status at pinned S revision, including missing state, incompatible embedding selectors and an X request for native payload.
cases.expected: S supplies authorized, revision-scoped representation/status projection with unknown/missing fields and explicit unsupported outcomes; X never receives native payload, and a read grants no mutation rights.
cases.verification_kind: planned implementation case; design counterexample only

external_dependencies.governance: Independent external model service; included in full pair matrix.
external_dependencies.obligations: R/X separately admit disclosure and cost; pin provider/model/prompt/preprocessing; agree tenant isolation, retention, quota, usage and unknown-completion handling.

external_dependencies.governance: Unspecified native source(s) entering existing O append; not invented as deployable components.
operations: O -> source append result, semantics unspecified

feedback_reviews.analysis: The full SCC contains O/S receipt-representation replay, S/R identity/inference proposal/admission, S/X acceptance/report simplification, X/R acquisition suggestions, and R/X use of shared M. Grounding is separated by native/generated lineage; generated answers cannot reenter O. Shared M and common S support make confidence correlated. Missingness and selection history travel with results. Stable work IDs and one budget bound repeated inquiry; local owner commits hold no cross-owner locks and do not wait for M/X/R; intake has separately reserved capacity. S local transaction stops lost-cursor cycles; expired O history produces gaps rather than invented recovery. Stale simplification proposals conflict, and model-space transitions do not pool embeddings. All policy/capacity assertions require product evidence; see F08-F11.

findings.description: O acknowledgement is nonexistent; S checkpoints before representation commit and recovery is unsound.
findings.smallest_correction: Remove O acknowledgement; S atomically commits representations, applied occurrence IDs and local cursor. Endpoint durability/stream semantics remain F10.

findings.description: Content-hash deduplication erases independent repeated occurrences and can corrupt physical-identity association.
findings.smallest_correction: Deduplicate delivery by scoped occurrence ID; retain payload hash only as content equality; S owns correction lineage.

findings.description: R generated answers reenter O as ordinary external evidence, enabling self-confirmation.
findings.smallest_correction: Route generated inference to S as a typed proposal with parent/model lineage; deny R generated append to O.

findings.description: R/X direct writes compete for S physical identity and accepted-state authority.
findings.smallest_correction: Preserve four applications; S is sole durable admission/commit authority; R/X propose at expected revisions.

findings.description: Unbounded acquisition retries lack stable identities, path budgets and failure isolation from native intake.
findings.smallest_correction: Stable work/request IDs, one bounded end-to-end budget, reserved native intake capacity and explicit exhaustion; no new queue service.

findings.description: Indefinite evidence references do not retain seven-day O payloads or guarantee replay after a long outage.
findings.smallest_correction: Keep reference metadata with availability horizon and gaps; disclose expired evidence and limit recovery claims. Do not introduce an unrequired permanent payload archive.

findings.description: One embedding field mixes incompatible model spaces and hides shared M dependence.
findings.smallest_correction: Version embedding spaces and expose M shared lineage; no cross-space pooling without explicit migration.

findings.description: Acquire-new-observation mission has no specified outside source/action owner or permitted operation.
findings.smallest_correction: Name authorized source/provider, requested action, request/result/effect ports, identity, budgets, retention and evidence; until then only reread O and return acquisition_unavailable.

findings.description: M provider identity/revision, confidentiality, tenancy, retention, quotas, billing and failure behavior are unspecified.
findings.smallest_correction: Agree pinned M request/result contracts, disclosure policy and shared quota/budget policy before enabling calls. No model call is part of this review.

findings.description: Endpoint schemas, native append admission/result semantics, O durability/cursor/expiry semantics, S transaction/admission policies and numeric resource limits lack endpoint agreement.
findings.smallest_correction: Approve concrete endpoint schemas and local owner policies, including exact expiry horizon, atomicity, dedup retention, positive intake reservation and bounded configuration. All current contracts are proposed.

findings.description: No pinned implementation/configuration or executed required product cases exist.
findings.smallest_correction: Implement only after separate authorization, then run required cases at pinned revisions/configuration; checker success and design walkthroughs are not product qualification.

review.scope_limit: Self-review of a proposed design from one pinned file, not independent endpoint/runtime review. Four applications retained; M is external. Open acquisition capability prevents full intended architecture approval. Contracts proposed; no product cases executed.

facets.ownership: Unnamed native source owns its submitted content/source claim. O alone admits, assigns occurrence identity, commits receipt and applies seven-day payload retention. S representations are not committed by append.
facets.authority: Existing append(payload) is the only named ingress operation. Proposed admission allows authenticated/explicitly unknown native source envelopes according to policy and denies R/M generated material disguised as native evidence. No acquisition, source verification, physical action or downstream acceptance follows from append.
facets.shape_versions: Existing payload shape is unspecified; preserve exact native payload and unknown fields, add versioned envelope with claimed source/epoch, native origin, source time/uncertainty when known, optional source event ID and O receipt metadata. Source identity verification and allowed schema/extensions await agreement.
facets.identity_scope: O receipt occurrence ID distinguishes identical payloads and repeated events. Source event ID scoped to source+epoch can support agreed append idempotency but content hash alone cannot. O occurrence identity does not prove physical identity or source authenticity.
facets.time_order: Carry source event/valid time when known, source clock uncertainty, O receipt time, S commit/knowledge revision and model time/version when used. Cursor orders the O receipt stream only; no global source-time order. Late corrections refer to prior revisions.
facets.delivery_idempotency: Append retry semantics are unspecified by the source. Proposed source event/request IDs and fingerprints must be agreed before claiming idempotent retry; until then uncertain append completion may duplicate occurrences and must not be deduplicated by content. No source/consumer acknowledgement operation is invented.
facets.commit_recovery: O append durability, ID assignment and receipt response point are unspecified. Proposed atomic receipt+occurrence+payload persistence precedes durable success; whether this is available is F10. An append success never commits S or extends payload retention.
facets.retention: O retains native payloads seven days; exact start/boundary, tombstone metadata, source resend horizon and export/restore behavior require agreement. Expired data is unavailable rather than missing evidence invented by a model.
facets.resource_limits: Agree source authentication/admission, finite payload bytes and append rate, O storage high-water policy, native positive capacity reservation and fair source limits. O accepts no promise of unbounded storage or blocking until S/M succeeds. Numeric limits are unselected.
facets.errors: Append outcome must distinguish durable success, rejected/denied, unsupported schema, storage/queue capacity, partial/timeout and unknown completion where available. Existing endpoint error shapes are absent; do not advertise idempotency or durable success until pinned.
facets.feedback_grounding: Carry native/generated classification, source occurrences, model/version/prompt lineage, selection/missingness and parent work IDs. Generated results remain inference, shared model/evidence counts once for independence, proposals remain proposals until S admission, and operational acceptance never proves external truth.
